title: Choose the visual direction
question: The concept roll ran in degraded mode and returned one direction without challengers. Keep the assigned direction, choose the familiar category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Islamabad Tax Circulars
options.lineage: Pakistan tax circulars and formal firm notices
options.thesis: A familiar accounting app gains its character from the precise rhythm of professional tax documents.
options.viewport: A compact app header and side navigation frame the Monday–Saturday timesheet matrix, with client, engagement, and Pakistan task codes beside quarter-hour cells and daily totals.
options.risk: Formal typography can feel generic if task codes and time-entry states lose their hierarchy.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished accounting workspace with the expected tables, filters, and navigation.
canonCard.viewport: A compact sidebar and top bar frame a weekly timesheet table with clear totals and submission actions.
canonCard.risk: It follows familiar accounting software conventions throughout.
